Я не просив жодних «спеціальних пропозицій», додаткових програм чи пояснень — я чітко попросив повернення коштів. Якщо клієнт прямо відмовляється від послуги, нормальна компанія просто оформлює повернення, а не витрачає час на нав’язування своїх продуктів.

Дуже неприємний досвід із підтримкою. Складається враження, що головне для компанії — не задоволення клієнта, а максимально ускладнити процес повернення грошей.

Сподіваюся, Ultiself перегляне своє ставлення до клієнтів.

Даже если заблокируете в меню карты эту подписку, то при следующем списании может быть другой терминал, и вы всё равно потеряете свои деньги. title: Stay away from this app
body:
I've been reading recent reviews and realized that I've run into the same issue.

I signed up for a trial through Ultiself’s website using Apple Pay. The app instructs users to manage subscriptions via the App Store — yet no active subscription appears there. There's no clear or accessible way to cancel.

About 14–18 days after signing up, I was charged $49 — with no explanation. I never activated any additional subscriptions within the app. I contacted support immediately after the charge, but have received no response since. Any response!

Now I understand why this app has such a low rating on the App Store — that was a red flag I unfortunately ignored. I strongly advise against downloading this app.

Everything about the experience suggests a highly deceptive setup: misleading subscription handling, no way to cancel, and a complete lack of customer support. Stay away!

title: Troublesome app
body:
UltiSelf is the worst app I’ve ever encountered. It honestly feels like a scam designed to squeeze money out of users. I signed up for a one-week subscription to test whether it would work for me. After just one day, I realized it absolutely didn’t suit my needs.

I decided to cancel the subscription and request a refund, as promised in their ads — “If it’s not for you, we’ll give your money back.” But it turned out you can’t cancel the subscription yourself — you have to email them. I did so, clearly explaining my case and asking for cancellation and a refund.

My message was simply ignored. Instead of addressing my request, they kept replying with new offers — discounts, bonuses, alternative deals — anything but actually helping me. I emailed them every day for a week, repeating my request, but got no meaningful response.

It became obvious that their support was stalling intentionally, waiting for the next billing cycle to hit. I had to block my card to prevent any further charges. Only after that — when they couldn’t withdraw money — did they finally reply, promising a refund within 10 days.

They clearly feel no remorse and do this systematically. Other reviews mention the same scheme. This is a real scam.
author: Brapoel

title: Unfair charges after subscription cancellation – refund requested

I demand a full refund for the unauthorized charges and urge others to be very cautious with this app. Apple should investigate this issue and take appropriate action.

title: Beware of scammers!
body:
This app is a total scam. It redirects users to their website, secretly collects payment details, and charges money without clear consent. In my case, they first took $39.95, then secretly charged the same amount again without any notifications!

When I tried to contact support, they blocked my email accounts and deleted all emails from them, making it impossible to reach them. There’s no subscription in the App Store, so you can’t cancel through Apple, making refunds extremely difficult.

This is a classic scam—lure users in, steal their data, and then ignore all refund requests. Do not download this app unless you want to lose your money! Apple should investigate and remove it from the store immediately.

title: Transformative Motivational Program: A Catalyst for Personal Growth
body:
This motivational program truly changed my perspective on my abilities and sense of self-discipline. Previously, I was in a state of inertia; even just getting out of bed seemed like an incredibly daunting task. But thanks to this program, I found the strength and motivation to move forward.

It provided me with a clear purpose and strategies that helped me step by step to actualize myself. Every day, it inspired me to get out of bed with renewed enthusiasm and readiness for achievements. Through regular reminders, positive prompts, and practical tasks, I learned to manage my time and focus on key goals.

Now, I look at each new day with great hope and confidence that every step I take will lead me to achieve my dreams. I am grateful for this program, which has become a true guide to a new, more successful, and fulfilling life.
